captions.text: The next day I met him again, and he spoke.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: First of all, let us look at the political and economic aspect:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: What kind of men allow humanity to progress?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The geniuses.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Your world must therefore revalue the geniuses and allow them to direct the Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You have had successively in power the brutes who were superior to the others by muscular force, the rich who had the means to have many brutes in their service, and the politicians, who trapped the peoples of the democratic countries with their hopes, not to mention the military who based their success on a rational organization of brutality.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The only type of man you have never placed in power is precisely the one who makes humanity progress.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Whether he discovers the wheel, gunpowder, the internal-combustion engine, or the atom, the genius has always made the power of men less intelligent than himself benefit from his inventions, often using peaceful inventions for murderous ends.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This must change!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For that, the elections and the votes must be abolished, which are completely unsuited in their present form to the evolution of humanity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Men are all the useful cells of an immense body which is called humanity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The cell of the foot does not have to say whether the hand should or should not take an object.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is the brain that must decide, and if this object is good, the cell of the foot will benefit from it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It does not have to vote, since it is made to advance the whole of which the brain is a part, and is not able to judge whether what the hand can take is good or bad.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Votes are positive only when there is equality of knowledge and of intellectual levels.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Copernicus was condemned, by a majority of incapable people, because he was the only one to have a level sufficient to understand.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And yet the Earth was not the center of the world as the Church believed; it did indeed turn around the sun.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When the first car drove, if everyone had been made to vote to know whether cars should be authorized or forbidden, the answer of the people, who knew nothing of the automobile and did not care about it, would have been negative, and you would still be driving in a horse-drawn carriage.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: How to change all that?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You now have psychologists who are capable of creating tests for evaluating the intelligence and the adaptation of each individual.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: From childhood these tests must be applied systematically in order to define the orientation of the subject's studies, and when the individual passes to the age where he becomes responsible, his intellectual coefficient must finally be delimited, which will be marked on his identity or voter card.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Eligible for any public post whatever will be only the individuals having an intellectual coefficient superior by 50% to the average, and only those having an intellectual coefficient superior by 10% to the average will be able to be voters.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Many of your present politicians could no longer exercise their functions if this existed today.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is a wholly democratic system.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There are engineers who have an intelligence inferior to the average but who have a great deal of memory and have passed heaps of diplomas thanks to that, and there are workers or peasants not even specialized who have an intelligence more than 50% superior to the average…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: What is inadmissible at present is that the voice of what you vulgarly call a fool counts as much as that of a genius who has thought maturely about the way in which he was going to vote.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In certain small towns, the elections are won by the one who has offered the most aperitifs…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And not by the one whose projects are the most interesting.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: So, at the start, the right to vote reserved for the intellectual elite, for those whose brain is the most apt to reflect and to find solutions to problems.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They are not necessarily those who have done a great deal of study.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is a matter of placing the genius in power; you can call that geniocracy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Second point: your world is paralyzed by profit, and communism does not manage to give men a carrot sufficient for them to want to make efforts and to progress.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You are born equal; that too is in the biblical writings.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The power must make you be born approximately equal in fortune.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is inadmissible that little intelligent children can live in opulence thanks to the fortune their fathers amassed while geniuses starve and do any low task whatever in order to manage to eat, thus neglecting occupations where they could have made discoveries benefiting the whole of humanity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To avoid that, property must be abolished without, however, instituting communism.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This world is not yours; that too is written in the Bible.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You are only its tenants.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Thus, all goods must be leased for forty-nine years.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That abolishes the injustice of inheritances.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Your inheritance, the inheritance of your children, is the whole world if you know how to organize yourselves to make it pleasant.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This political orientation of humanity is not communism; it concerns itself with the future of humanity; call it Humanitarianism if you want to give it a name.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Let us take an example: a man has finished his studies at twenty-one and he wants to enter active life; he chooses a profession and earns money.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If he wants, his parents being still alive, to house himself, he buys a house; he in reality leases a house or an apartment for forty-nine years from the State, which had it built.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If the dwelling is estimated at one hundred thousand francs, he will pay this sum in monthly installments for forty-nine years.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: At seventy years (21 + 49) he will have paid for his house and will be able to live in it, no longer paying anything until his death.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: At his death, this house will revert to the State, which will have to leave the free enjoyment of it to the children of the deceased if he has any.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Suppose there is one; this one will enjoy his father's house free of charge all his life.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: At his death, his child too will be able to enjoy the family house, and this eternally.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Inheritance must be completely abolished, except for the family house.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This does not prevent the merit of each from being rewarded.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Let us take another example: a man has two children; one is very hardworking, the other lazy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: At twenty-one, they each decide to follow their own path.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They will each lease a house worth 100,000 F. The hardworking one will very quickly earn more money than the lazy one.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He will then be able to lease a house costing twice as much in place of the first.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If he has the means, he will even be able to lease both, one serving him as a country house.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He will also be able, if his savings are fruitful, to have built and to lease himself for forty-nine years this house, the money reverting to him.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But at his death everything will revert to the community, except the family house, which will revert to his children.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In a way, a man can make a fortune for himself, according to his merit, but not for his children.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To each his merit.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For commercial and industrial enterprises, it is the same thing.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The one who has created a business, it is his for his whole life and he can lease it, but never for more than forty-nine years.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The farmers too, their lands, they can lease them for forty-nine years in order to exploit them; afterward, they revert to the State, which will be able to re-lease them for forty-nine years.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The son can re-lease them for forty-nine years.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It must be thus for all goods that remain exploitable; nothing is changed as to the value of things.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Stocks, gold, enterprises, ready money, buildings, everything that can have value, everything belongs to the community but can be leased for forty-nine years by those who have acquired the means by their merit and their work.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Thus a man having made a fortune around the age of forty will be able to have buildings built, to lease them as apartments for forty-nine years, and to enjoy this money until his death.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Afterward, the money coming from these leases will revert to the community.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This humanitarianism is already prescribed in the Bible:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Thou shalt count for thee seven sabbaths of years, seven times seven years: forty-nine years.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When therefore thou shalt make a sale to thy neighbor, or thou shalt buy from the hand of thy neighbor, do not wrong one another.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: According to the number of years after the Jubilee thou shalt buy from thy neighbor; according to the number of years of crops he shall sell to thee.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: According as the years increase, thou shalt increase its price, and according as the years diminish, thou shalt diminish its price, for it is a number of crops that he sells to thee.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: the land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine, while you are guests and residents with me.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If the genius is admitted to power, he will understand the usefulness of these reforms.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You must also bring it about that all the nations of the Earth ally themselves so as to have no more than a single government.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: World government
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: What will allow you to arrive at it is the creation of a new world currency and of a single language.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Auvergnat is no longer spoken at Clermont-Ferrand; French will soon no longer be spoken at Paris, nor English at London, nor German at Frankfurt.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Your scientists and your language specialists must unite and work to create a new language, inspired by all of them and made obligatory in the schools of the whole world as a second language.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For the currency it is the same thing: the world value can be neither the franc, nor the dollar, nor the yen, but a new currency created for the needs of the whole Earth without wronging a people which would wonder why that of another country was chosen instead of its own.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Finally, the detonator necessary to such a union is the suppression of military service, which teaches the young men only things serving aggressiveness, and the placing of career military men in the service of public order.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This must intervene in all the countries at the same time, an indispensable guarantee of security.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Your mission
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: As I have already told you, we know that our official coming would accelerate many things.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But we will wait for that to see that men truly desire to see us come, that they love us and respect us as the fathers that we are.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That our craft not be threatened by your destructive warlike forces.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To arrive at that, clamor throughout the world that you have met me, and repeat what I have told you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The wise will listen to you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Many will take you for a madman or a visionary, but I have explained to you above what to think of imbecile majorities.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You know the truth, and we will remain in contact with you by telepathy to give you back confidence and to give you supplementary information if we find that necessary.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: What we want is to see whether there are enough wise people on the Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If a large enough number follow you, we will return in broad daylight.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Where?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In the place that you will have had arranged to receive us.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Have a residence built in a country pleasant with a mild climate, comprising seven rooms always ready to receive guests, each having a bathroom, a conference room able to receive at least twenty-one persons, a swimming pool, a dining room able to accommodate twenty-one persons.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This residence must be built in the middle of a park.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It must be sheltered from indiscreet glances.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The park will be entirely enclosed by walls, preventing the residence and the swimming pool from being seen.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The residence must be situated at least 1,000 meters from the wall surrounding the park.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It will be at most one story high and must be concealed from the vicinity of the wall by a curtain of vegetation.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Two entrances will exist in the surrounding wall.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One to the North, the other to the South.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The residence will also possess two entrances.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: On the roof of the residence there will be a terrace on which a craft twelve meters in diameter can land.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: An access from this terrace to the interior is indispensable.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The aerial space situated above and around this residence must not be subjected to a military surveillance, direct or carried out by radar.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You will try to obtain that the ground where this residence will be established, if possible vaster than is prescribed, be considered as neutral ground by the nations and by the country where it will have been chosen, by virtue of our terrestrial embassy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You will be able to live with your wife and your children in this residence, which will be placed under your direction, and you will be able to have servants and guests there whom you will have chosen.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: However, the part containing the seven rooms must be situated immediately under the access terrace and separated from the places used by men by a thick metal door, permanently closed and able to be locked from the inside.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: An asepticization airlock must be built at the entrance of the conference room.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The financing of this realization will be possible thanks to the aid you will obtain from those who will believe in you, therefore in us, and who will therefore be wise and intelligent.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: These will be rewarded when we come.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Keep a file of those who will contribute financially to the realization, however modest their contribution may be, to the building or the maintenance of this residence, and take, throughout the world, in each nation, a person responsible for the divulgation of the truth, allowing people to unite to spread it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Have, near the residence, on a mountain, people from the whole world come every year, the people who wish to see us come after having taken knowledge of these writings.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Let them be the greatest number possible, and make them think of us, intensely wish for our coming.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When they are numerous enough and have intensely enough the desire to see us, without religious mysticism, as responsible men but respecting their creators, we will come in broad daylight and we will give the men of the Earth our scientific inheritance.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If the warlike temperaments are reduced to a total impotence in the whole world, that will happen.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If the love of life and of humanity for us, and therefore for itself, is strong enough, yes, we will come in broad daylight.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We will wait; and if man remains aggressive and progresses in a way dangerous for the other worlds, we will annihilate this civilization and the points where it conserves its scientific riches, and it will be new Sodom and Gomorrah while waiting for humanity to be worthy, morally, of its scientific level.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The future of man is in his hands and the truth is in yours.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Spread it throughout the world and do not be discouraged.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We will never help you openly nor in any way that could serve as proof to the skeptics, skepticism often going hand in hand with aggressiveness.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The intelligent will believe you, for what you are going to say has nothing mystical.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That is important for us; that you be believed without material proof proves to us more than anything else that one is intelligent and therefore worthy of receiving from us the scientific inheritance.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Now, go; you will not be forgotten if you triumph during your terrestrial life and even after, if we must wait for your descendants to come, for scientifically we will be able to make you live again, as well as all those who will have led men onto the path of human genius, with the love of the creators for guide, on condition that their remains be conserved in tombs.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Our only aid will limit itself to appearing from now on more and more frequently in order to sensitize people to the problem and to give them the desire to take knowledge of the truth that you transmit to them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Progressively, thanks to more and more frequent appearances, we will arrive at public opinion's being sensitized and at our appearances no longer triggering a stupid adoration, but a profound desire for the populations to enter into contact with us.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Your movement you will call it the Raëlian Movement.
captions.speaker: Yahweh
